# v2.49-dev Release Notes

## Fixed the mobile menu leaving dark bands after closing

On mobile, opening the navigation menu correctly dims the page behind the
drawer — but after closing it, a dark tint could stay stuck over the top
status-bar area and the bottom address-bar area of the screen while the rest of
the page looked fine.

### Fixed

- **Mobile menu no longer leaves a dark tint behind.** The dimming backdrop is
  now kept in place and faded out instead of being removed outright, which
  avoids a mobile-browser repaint quirk that left the top and bottom edges
  darkened after the menu closed. Closing the menu — whether by the ✕, tapping
  outside, or following a link — now leaves the page completely clean.

### Notes

- Visual/behavioural fix only. No database migration and no configuration
  required. Opening, closing, and tapping outside the menu all work exactly as
  before.
